title: SemTree: Judge-Aware Semantic Decision Trees for Inspectable and Repairable Rule Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2610.13999v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rule decisions such as content moderation, advertising compliance, and eligibility checks combine several conditions, exemptions, and missing-information cases, and an error can be fixed only once the failing condition is known. We introduce SemTree, a framework that represents a rule decision as a semantic decision tree: each node is a natural-language question with explicit Yes/No/Unknown criteria, a pluggable semantic judge answers it, and the branching structure is compiled on the answers that this judge actually gives. The executed path is the reasoning behind every decision, so errors are repaired where they occur: a reviewer corrects a single node and replays the rule, corrected nodes become training labels for the judge, and a tool-using LLM editor revises questions and subtrees while observing execution results. On all 8,276 ShARC test cases, a tree executed by a hosted judge reaches 67.70% accuracy with 2.99 questions per cas

translated_title: SemTree：面向可检查、可修复规则决策的评判器感知语义决策树
translated_abstract: 规则决策（如内容审核、广告合规和资格审核）通常结合了多个条件、豁免情形和 信息缺失情况，而只有当知晓失败的具体条件后才能修复错误。我们提出了SemTree，一个将规则决策表示为语义决策树的框架：每个节点是一个带有明确“是/否/未知”判据的自然语言问题，由一个可插拔的语义评判器进行回答，而分支结构则是根据该评判器实际给出的答案编译而成。执行路径即为每个决策背后的推理过程，因此错误可以在其发生之处被修复：审核人员只需纠正单个节点并重新执行规则，被纠正的节点便成为评判器的训练标签，同时一个具备工具使用能力的大语言模型编辑器在观察执行结果的过程中修订问题与子树。在全部8,276个ShARC测试用例上，由托管评判器执行的决策树达到了67.70%的准确率，每个用例平均仅需2.99个问题……
tldr: SemTree将规则决策表示为由自然语言问题节点构成的语义决策树，由可插拔的语义评判器逐节点作答，使每次决策的推理路径可检查、错误可在具体节点被修复并转化为训练标签，并借助LLM编辑器自动改进问题与子树。
en_tdlr: SemTree represents rule decisions as semantic decision trees whose nodes are natural-language questions answered by a pluggable semantic judge, making the reasoning behind every decision inspectable and repairable at specific nodes, with corrections becoming training labels and an LLM editor refining questions and subtrees.
